preconditions.description: The number of test cases T must be between 1 and 5.
The number of cities N must be between 2 and 5000.
The number of roads proposed by other companies M1 and Chef's company M2 must each be between 1 and 20000.

preconditions.expression: all(0 <= c <= 1000000000 for c in costs)
preconditions.description: The cost of each road must be between 0 and 1,000,000,000.

postconditions.description: If it is impossible to connect all cities with the given roads, output 'Impossible'.
If a valid subset of roads is found, output the maximum profit and the minimum total cost of the chosen roads.
